page: Microsoft Azure M416bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance engineered for massive in-memory computing workloads. Built on the x86_64 architecture using Intel processors managed via Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 416 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 3,800 GB of system memory, establishing a configuration ratio of 9.13 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware accelerators, leaving both local disk capacity and GPU counts at zero. Storage connectivity relies strictly on remote network-attached block storage, with architectural support for Azure Premium Storage to fulfill data persistence and high block-storage throughput requirements. Network configuration does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses, matching standard enterprise virtual network deployment models.

Operating at this tier represents an infrastructure profile focused on scale-up resource density rather than distributed horizontal scaling. The substantial core count combined with 3.8 TB of RAM reduces inter-node networking overhead for monolithic data structures, though the absence of onboard scratch disks requires reliance on external block storage pipes for high-throughput persistent I/O. As a result, the M416bs_v3 is suited for enterprise in-memory databases, massive SAP HANA deployments, relational database engines, and intensive transactional business applications.
description: Microsoft Azure M416bs_v3 is a high-density, memory-optimized instance built on the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors and Microsoft Hyper-V. The system provides 416 dedicated virtual CPUs alongside 3,800 GB of system RAM, delivering an allocation of 9.13 GB per core. The instance includes no onboard local storage and no GPU accelerators, routing all persistent disk operations to external block storage with native support for Premium Storage. By concentrating hundreds of dedicated execution threads and terabytes of memory into a single virtual server, it eliminates the latency and network overhead inherent in distributed clustering. The architecture necessitates planning around remote block storage throughput for IOPS-heavy data processing. The M416bs_v3 is designed specifically for monolithic memory-bound operations, including massive in-memory databases, large SAP HANA systems, data warehousing engines, and critical enterprise transactional backends.
